resources.string: Enroll this phone using a one-time token from the VAJRA web console. Private keys stay in Android Keystore.
Token, device ID, and challenge nonce are required.
Pairing bundle applied. Review details and tap Submit enrollment.

Removes the local Keystore key and stops heartbeats. Also revoke the device from the web console if it remains listed.

VAJRA Companion protects devices you own.

Data: device id, public key fingerprint, OS/agent version, command receipts, optional event metadata.

Not collected: keystrokes, SMS, contacts, photos, microphone, camera, continuous location (not in this version).

Permissions: INTERNET; POST_NOTIFICATIONS for ring alerts.

Disconnect anytime in Settings. Confirm or revoke devices in the web console.
Open the VAJRA web console on your computer, click \'Connect Device\', and scan the QR code displayed on screen.
Enter the 6-digit verification passcode shown below the QR code on your computer screen.
Identity verified! Please click \'Approve & Protect Device\' on your web console to grant access.
This device is securely enrolled with hardware-backed cryptographic keys in Android Keystore.
Cryptographic zero-trust mesh protecting this Android endpoint with hardware-bound keys and tamper-evident telemetry.
VAJRA requires camera access solely to scan pairing QR codes. No photos or video are recorded or transmitted.
Camera permission is required to scan the pairing QR code. You can enable it in device Settings, or paste the pairing code directly from your clipboard.
The device owner declined this authorization request in the VAJRA console.
The enrollment challenge has expired. Please generate a fresh pairing QR code in the VAJRA console.
